# Lane's Lexicon (excerpt)

Edward William Lane, _An Arabic-English Lexicon_, London: Williams and Norgate, 1863–1893.

Original digitization provided by the Perseus Digital Library at Tufts University, under the support of the U.S. Department of Education and the Max Planck Society. Corrections to digitization added by the Alpheios Project, Ltd.

The digitization is licensed under the [Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 United States License](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/us/). Source: [alpheios-project/lan](https://github.com/alpheios-project/lan) at commit `7dd04e1182c13a4b0883978867d2a3b04616542a` ([upstream attribution and licence at that revision](https://github.com/alpheios-project/lan/blob/7dd04e1182c13a4b0883978867d2a3b04616542a/README.md)).

`form-i.json` holds the first Form I entry under each root that the site's verb lists use. Markup is removed and whitespace normalised; the wording is unchanged. Changes: extraction and markup removal only. This folder keeps its own licence and is not covered by the licence of the site code. See [docs/data/copyright-policy.md](../../../docs/data/copyright-policy.md).

A root-level reference to this extract is comparison evidence only unless the reviewer confirms the exact vocalized lemma, imperfect stem and intended sense. The first Form I article is not a complete inventory of the root's senses or conjugations.
